title: Bolivian smudge
description: Most of the time, when you look up at the sky from the back seat of the car, you’ll see a smudge that indicates, first, that you’re in Bolivia (this doesn’t happen in Peru), and second, that you’re in the region south of Cochabamba—with the exception of two roads on the Altiplano near La Paz, which are easily recognizable.

title: Oruro burning waste
description: On road 6, south east of Oruro, you'll often see burning waste along the road.

title: Rock spires south-east of La Paz
description: Very steep rock formations that seem to rise straight out of the ground, combined with Andean architecture, indicate one of the three roads leaving La Paz to the south-east.
